spans.s:
(ऋ) शेऌ r. 1st cl. (शेलति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To shake, to tremble.

(ऌ) षेलृ r. 1st cl. (सेलति)
To go, to move; also शेल, and सेल.

(ऋ) सेऌ r. 1st cl. (सेलति)
To go or move; preferably षेल.

m. (-लुः)
A small tree, (Cordia myxa.)
E.
शिल to glean, उ aff.

m. (-लुः)
A tree, (Cordia myxa): see शेलु.
